en: Rafa, congrats
on your first ATP Masters 1000 final.
We knew Daniil is a brilliant hard-court player,
one of the best of his generation.
He won here before.
So, what did you do today?
What did you prepare to go
into this match?
Yeah, I mean it was a very tough match
in the first set.
All the games were very very close,
you know, with break points for him,
break points for me.
So yeah, super happy how I handled,
you know, the important moments
in the first serve, in the first set, sorry.
And then also how I returned and served.
And yeah, Daniil is always a very tough player.
I think he played great today.
So I have to give my best level
to beat him.
Alejandro in the final tomorrow.
So it's going to be an all Spanish final
for the first time in nine years.
Does that make it even better for you?
Well, it will be another tough game
as every match
that I've played here.
So yeah, try to get ready in the best shape
as possible and give my best tomorrow.
Best of luck tomorrow.
Thank you.
Thank you.
